name: briefing_action_queue_add_delay_until_progress
description: Briefing_ActionQueue::AddDelayUntilProgress allocates a delay-until-progress action, stores the required progress as a float, inserts it into the briefing action queue, and returns the updated node count.
known_limits: Focused VC5 COFF byte comparison is clean in briefing_action_queue_add_methods; owner tier S remains deferred to the complete Briefing source-owner because tick bodies and the runtime constructor remain byte-blocked.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x404b40 validates allocation of an 8-byte delay action, integer-to-float progress storage, queue-node insertion, node-count increment, and return of the updated count.
The native briefing objective-action smoke verifies the expected delay progress ids for two objectives.
